identity: Dutch-taught LLB Rechtsgeleerdheid at University of Groningen, RIO 50700 and registry row 217. 2026–2027 OER art. 4.2 establishes a common first year and six tracks. Nederlands Recht is the broad continuation of private, criminal, constitutional and administrative law; route choice is made on the target curriculum before UCR fit.
sourceUse: OER Appendix 2 §§1 and 6 control compulsory credits and the restricted choice. The degree page gives year-2/year-3 placement. The dated Ocasys URL responds and is supplementary. The distinct English-taught degree is outside this target.
components: Includes a computing practical for law students.
Students write a legal publication in the second research skills course.
Restricted choice: one of the two approved introductory courses.
Capstone combining a legal research paper, a written pleading, communication training and a simulated hearing.

progression.first-year: OER art. 5.2 sets a 45 EC first-year study-advice norm. General Law 2 includes IT for law students.
progression.capstone: Arts. 6.2–6.3 require 90 EC including all first-year courses and both legal research skills courses for the Dutch Law route before registration. Other tracks can use their named research alternatives. The capstone includes planning and writing a legal research paper and case solution, peer feedback, a pleading, communication training and a final hearing.
progression.choice: One 5 EC introductory course in legal philosophy or legal sociology. No open elective block is specified for this route.
